source_review.title: Novel imaging approaches for visualizing root–mycorrhizal fungal interactions
source_review.evidence_role: technology/methods review, not a comparative benchmark dataset

implementation.calibration_policy: absence downgrades quantitative/direct claim support; it is never defaulted
implementation.nutrient_delivery_policy: single modality observation always returns InsufficientAlone

direct_claims: HyphalMorphology3D when 3D support, z-resolution and calibration are present
HyphalMorphology3D when voxel depth, spatial resolution and calibration are present
ElementalDistribution when calibration and analyte identity are present
contextual_claims: ElementalDistribution when calibration or analyte identity is missing

direct_claims: ChemicalSpeciation when calibration and analyte identity are present
contextual_claims: ChemicalSpeciation when calibration or analyte identity is missing

direct_claims: RadiotracerDynamics when calibration, tracer identity and temporal resolution are present
contextual_claims: RadiotracerDynamics when required metadata is missing

direct_claims: LabelledParticleMovement when label identity and temporal resolution are present
contextual_claims: LabelledParticleMovement when label or temporal information is absent

direct_claims: ElectricalSignalDynamics when calibration and temporal resolution are present

required_known_answer_cases: micro-CT supports 3D morphology only with calibrated depth resolution
XRF elemental distribution does not imply chemical speciation
XANES speciation does not imply transport
PET tracer dynamics do not imply fungal-route transfer without controls
fluorescent nanoparticle movement identifies only the labelled particle
electrical signal recordings are not mass-flow measurements
brightfield Z-stacks support geometry, not chemistry
missing analyte/tracer identity downgrades chemical claims
single modality can never prove nutrient delivery to host
source and calibration receipt IDs must resolve and validate
experimental_controls_required_for_nutri: tracer or element enrichment measured at recipient
microbial-only control where bacteria could mediate transfer
time ordering aligned across acquisition clocks
claim_ceiling: A modality observation qualifies one measurement channel. It does not prove fungal transport, host nutrient delivery, metabolic rate, common-network function or causality.
